rows.role_title: 中央委員会議長 — Central Committee chair
rows.text: The Secretariat's communiqué dated 17 January 2004 reports that the first plenum met on 17 January during the 23rd Congress and unanimously elected the four principal officers, the Central Committee chair, the Executive Committee chair, the head of the Secretariat and the vice-chairs ('一致して、中央委員会議長、幹部会委員長、書記局長、幹部会副委員長（三人）の四役を選出した'); it names no person elected.

locator.section: date line and first two paragraphs

rows.role_title: 中央委員会議長 — Central Committee chair
rows.text: It reports that at the plenum 不破哲三議長 called on the central officers to resolve to give their all ('総会では、不破哲三議長が、「…」と呼びかけた').
